limits: This is a context-conditioned partial word proposal, not a uniquely recovered complete historical message.
The prior A5 proposal motivates the dative KOHLENZUEGEN. Its source coordinates are not copied into A6.
All 74 observed A6 coordinates remain unchanged. Forty-four of 86 existing printed masks are supplied; 42 masks remain unresolved in the candidate.
N at plaintext 11 has an equal-price X alternative; the A5 syntax motivates, but does not prove, the dative plural.
The routing field at positions 28 through 40 is retained exactly as raw output, including its fixed A and G. Neither Marienburg nor Blankenburg is selected.
The last 24 positions retain the exact raw output; no signature, number, date or station is supplied.
All five missing square cells remain globally unassigned and injective over digits 5 through 9. Complete witnesses fill remaining coordinate masks arbitrarily for compatibility checks only.
The bounded language-model exploration that suggested word spans does not establish historical uniqueness; no model score is used as a decipherment certificate.
